panels.rationale: This is a patient-derived bronchoalveolar lavage cytology image demonstrating the characteristic thick-walled, broad-based budding yeasts of Blastomyces in pulmonary blastomycosis. [raw subtype: pulmonary blastomycosis]

panels.figure_caption: Calcofluor white stain of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from a patient with severe pulmonary blastomycosis highlighting multiple thick-walled broad-based budding yeasts (40× magnification).

Body fluids can be viewed using calcofluor white stain (Figure 2); sputum is often stained with Papanicolaou stain, which readily shows the large yeast forms of Blastomyces [37,39].
